upholstery-cleaning.metaTitle: Upholstery cleaning in Bansko | Wet&Dry Cleaning
upholstery-cleaning.metaDescription: Sofas, mattresses, carpets, curtains and car seats cleaned at your place in Bansko. Injection-extraction, dries in 2 to 4 hours. Free offer within a few hours.
upholstery-cleaning.h1: Upholstery and textile cleaning in Bansko
upholstery-cleaning.intro: We clean sofas, mattresses, carpets, curtains and car seats where they are. No transport, no dismantling. The machine injects a cleaning solution deep into the fabric and pulls it straight back out with the dirt, so the textile is left barely damp and dries in 2 to 4 hours.
includes: Sofas, armchairs and corner units, any fabric
Mattresses, including dust mite and allergen removal
Carpets, rugs and fitted carpet
Curtains cleaned in place, no removal needed
Car seats, mats and headliner
Stain and odour treatment, including pet smells

faq.q: Do I need to move the furniture?
faq.a: No. We come with everything we need and clean on the spot. We only ask for a little space around the piece.

faq.q: How long before I can use it again?
faq.a: The fabric is barely damp when we leave. Two to four hours and it is ready to use.

faq.q: Will old stains come out?
faq.a: Most of the time, yes. Send a photo of the stain and we will tell you honestly what to expect before we start.

deep-cleaning.metaTitle: Deep cleaning in Bansko | Wet&Dry Cleaning
deep-cleaning.metaDescription: Top-to-bottom deep cleaning of flats and houses in Bansko, Razlog, Dobrinishte and Banya. Free offer within a few hours.
deep-cleaning.intro: The clean you do once or twice a year, not the weekly one. We take a flat or a house room by room, from degreasing the kitchen to the skirting boards. Useful before moving in, after a season, or when a rental needs to go back to a proper standard.
includes: Kitchen, including inside cupboards, oven and extractor
Bathroom, limescale and grout
Floors, skirting boards and door frames
Windows from the inside, frames and sills
Dust on every surface, radiators and light fittings included
Upholstery and mattresses on request, with the injection-extraction machine

faq.q: How long does a deep clean take?
faq.a: A one-bedroom flat is usually half a day, a house takes longer. We tell you before we start, once we know the size and the state.

faq.q: Do you bring your own products and equipment?
faq.a: Yes, everything. You do not need to provide anything.

faq.q: Can you do it between two tenants?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the date the keys change and we work around it.

post-construction-cleaning.metaTitle: Post-construction cleaning in Bansko | Wet&Dry Cleaning
post-construction-cleaning.metaDescription: We clear plaster dust, paint and glue after building work in Bansko and the valley. The place goes back ready to move into.
post-construction-cleaning.intro: Building dust settles everywhere and comes back twice before it gives up. We take the site through several passes until the surfaces stay clean, then deal with paint marks, glue and silicone residue. We hand back a place someone can move into the same week.
includes: Several passes on plaster and cement dust until it stops coming back
Paint, glue, adhesive tape and silicone residue
Windows, frames and protective film removal
Radiators, sockets, switches and door frames
Floors, including grout washing
Packaging and small waste removal on request

faq.q: When should we come in?
faq.a: Once the trades are finished and the big debris is out. If we come too early the dust starts again.

faq.q: Do you take the rubble away?
faq.a: We remove packaging and small waste. Skips and building rubble are a separate job, tell us and we quote it.

faq.q: Can you work in an occupied building?
faq.a: Yes. In a hotel or a block of flats we work outside your busy hours and keep the corridors clear.

airbnb-turnover.metaTitle: Guest turnover cleaning in Bansko | Wet&Dry Cleaning
airbnb-turnover.metaDescription: Cleaning between guests for rental flats and guesthouses in Bansko. We work in the window between check-out and check-in.
airbnb-turnover.intro: Between one guest leaving and the next arriving there is often just a few hours. We work inside that window, the same way every time, so the flat is photo-ready and nothing gets forgotten in the rush. In high season we hold a slot for you rather than giving it to whoever calls first.
includes: The full flat, kitchen, bathroom, floors and surfaces
Beds made and linen changed
Bins emptied, consumables checked and restocked
Windows and mirrors, so the photos still match the listing
A message if something is broken, stained or missing
Upholstery and mattress cleaning between seasons

faq.q: How fast can you come after check-out?
faq.a: Usually within one to two hours. On a recurring contract your property gets priority.

faq.q: Do you handle the linen?
faq.a: We change it and can set the used set aside for your laundry service. Tell us how you want it organised.

faq.q: Can we book a whole season?
faq.a: Yes. A recurring contract fixes your slots ahead and brings the price per visit down.

window-cleaning.metaTitle: Window cleaning in Bansko | Wet&Dry Cleaning
window-cleaning.metaDescription: Windows, shopfronts and glass facades cleaned inside and out in Bansko, Razlog and Dobrinishte. Frames, sills and insect screens included.
window-cleaning.h1: Window and glass cleaning in Bansko
window-cleaning.intro: Glass shows every streak, so we do the frames and the sills too. Homes, shops, restaurants and offices. For anything above the ground floor or hard to reach we use poles, and we tell you upfront how high we can safely get.
includes: Windows inside and out, frames, sills and rubber seals
Shopfronts and glass doors
Glass façades and balcony balustrades
Skylights and roof windows where access allows
Insect screens taken out, washed and put back
Regular schedule for shops and restaurants

faq.q: Do you clean above the ground floor?
faq.a: Yes, with poles from the ground where the height allows. Beyond that we tell you honestly that the job needs proper access equipment.

faq.q: How often should a shopfront be done?
faq.a: In the centre of Bansko most shops go for every two weeks in season and monthly the rest of the year.

faq.q: Do you work in winter?
faq.a: Yes, with products that work below zero. We avoid the coldest hours.

pressure-washing.metaTitle: Pressure washing in Bansko | Wet&Dry Cleaning
pressure-washing.metaDescription: Terraces, driveways, yards and facades pressure washed in Bansko, Razlog and Dobrinishte. Moss, mud and green build-up removed. Free offer.
pressure-washing.intro: Stone, concrete and wood go green here, between the snowmelt and the summer rain. High pressure lifts moss, mud and the black film that builds up over the seasons. We set the pressure to the surface, because the same setting that cleans concrete will destroy soft wood.
includes: Terraces, paths and paved yards
Driveways, parking spaces and garage floors
Façades, plinths and stone walls
Wooden decking and fences, at reduced pressure
Stairs, balustrades and outdoor furniture
Seasonal wash, before summer or after the snow

faq.q: Will it damage the wood?
faq.a: Not if the pressure is set right. We test on a hidden corner first and work at a lower setting on soft wood.

faq.q: Do you need a water and power supply?
faq.a: Yes, a normal outdoor tap and a socket are enough. Tell us if you have neither and we will arrange it.

faq.q: When is the best time?
faq.a: Spring, once the snow has gone, and early autumn. Those are the two moments when the result lasts longest.

industrial-cleaning.metaDescription: Warehouses, production halls and retail floors cleaned in Bansko and the region. We work to a schedule, outside your opening hours. Invoice provided.
industrial-cleaning.h1: Industrial and large-surface cleaning in Bansko
industrial-cleaning.intro: Large floors need machines and a plan, not more people with mops. We survey the site, agree a schedule that fits around your operation, and come back on the same days so the standard holds. Every job is invoiced.
includes: Warehouse and production hall floors
Retail floors, aisles and stockrooms
Restaurant kitchens and back of house, at night
Common areas, stairwells and corridors
Glass fronts and entrance areas
Recurring contracts, weekly, monthly or seasonal

faq.q: Do you work outside opening hours?
faq.a: Yes, that is usually the point. Nights, early mornings, weekends, whatever fits your operation.

faq.q: Can you handle a large site?
faq.a: Yes. We size the crew and the equipment at the site visit and tell you what is realistic per session.

faq.q: Do you invoice companies?
faq.a: Yes, for every business job. That is standard for us, not an option.

items.q: Do I need to prepare anything before you come?
items.a: Almost nothing. We bring all the equipment and products. We only ask for a little space around what we are cleaning, and access to water and power.

items.q: How long does upholstery take to dry?
items.a: With injection-extraction the fabric dries in 2 to 4 hours, much faster than traditional wet cleaning. You can use your furniture the same day.

items.q: Is it safe for children and pets?
items.a: Yes. We only use certified, biodegradable products. Once dry, they leave no harmful residues.

items.q: What if something cannot be cleaned?
items.a: We look at the photos first and tell you honestly what to expect. If a stain or a mark is permanent we say so before we start, so there are no surprises.

items.q: How do you set the price and how do I pay?
items.a: Send us photos and a few details and you get an offer within a few hours. The price is fixed before we start. You pay after the job, by cash, bank transfer or Revolut. Businesses get an invoice, private customers on request.

items.q: Which areas do you cover?
items.a: We cover Bansko, Razlog, Dobrinishte, Banya and the entire Bansko-Razlog valley. For more distant locations, contact us.

items.q: How much does sofa cleaning cost in Bansko?
items.a: It depends on the size of the sofa, the fabric and its condition. That is why we quote from photos instead of a flat rate. Send us a photo and you get an exact price within a few hours. We fix it before we start and you pay after the job.

items.q: Can you remove pet odours and smells?
items.a: Yes. The injection-extraction method extracts contaminants from deep within the fabric, including odours from dogs, cats and cigarette smoke. For stronger odours, we apply enzyme-based treatments at no extra charge. Most clients report complete odour elimination after a single treatment.

items.q: Do you work with hotels and rental flats in Bansko?
items.a: Yes. We work with hotels, guesthouses and rental flats in Bansko and the surrounding area. We offer priority slots between guests and recurring cleaning contracts. See the business page or write to us for an offer.

items.q: Do you cover Dobrinishte, Banya and Razlog?
items.a: Yes, we cover Dobrinishte, Banya, Razlog and all villages in the Bansko-Razlog valley with no extra travel charge. For locations outside this area, please contact us in advance to confirm availability.

items.q: Do you work during ski season and on weekends?
items.a: Yes, we work every day from 08:00 to 20:00, including weekends and public holidays. Ski season (December–March) is our busiest period, we recommend booking at least 1–2 days in advance to secure your preferred time slot.

items.q: How often should sofas and mattresses be cleaned?
items.a: We recommend cleaning sofas at least once a year with normal use, or every 6 months if you have pets or young children. Mattresses should ideally be cleaned every 6–12 months, dust mites thrive in uncleaned mattresses and are a common cause of allergies and poor sleep.

items.q: What do you clean besides upholstery?
items.a: Deep cleaning of flats and houses, post-construction cleaning, guest turnover cleaning, windows and shopfronts, pressure washing for terraces and façades, and industrial cleaning of warehouses and retail floors.

items.q: Do you work with companies and large premises?
items.a: Yes. We work with warehouses, production halls, retail floors, restaurants and hotels. We do a free site visit, schedule outside your opening hours and issue an invoice for every job.
